ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered')
ርትዕ: ርትዕ — righteousness, uprightness (noun; subject of the 3fs verb ኀለፈት)
ወብዕልኒ: ብዕል — and wealth also (ወ- + noun + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
ፍርሀተ: ፍርሀት — fear (construct 'fear of') · also accusative, object: ያአትት ፍርሀተ 'he removes fear'
ነገረ: ነገር — word, matter, affair (noun, construct 'word of') · accusative 'a word, a matter' (ንንግርከኑ ነገረ 'may we tell you a matter?'; ch. 53)
ቃለ: ቃል — word (construct 'word of') · accusative 'a word' (ዘንተ ቃለ 'this word') · 'voice of' in the title ቃለ ታዕካ (?)
እምቃለ: ቃል — from the voice, word of (እም- + noun, construct)
ለእግዚኣብሔር: እግዚአብሔር — of/to God · God as object, marked with ለ- after ፈርሆ, አምዕዕዎ, አሥመሮ
ንዋየ: ንዋይ — goods, vessels, possessions (construct 'goods of') · accusative 'goods' (ወኵሎ ንዋየ ወሀበት 'and all goods she gave')
እምነ: እም — from, out of (preposition, እምነ before a noun) · 'our mother' (እም 'mother' + -ነ 'our'): ይብልዋ ለጽዮን እምነ 'they will call Zion "our mother"' · 'than' in a comparison (ተፈሥሑ ፈድፋደ እምነ እስራኤል 'rejoiced more than Israel')
ንዋመ: ንዋም — sleep (noun, accusative; cognate object 'slept a sleep')
አሌለነ: አሌ — woe to us (interjection አሌ + ለ- + -ነ '1cp us')
አንስቲያነ: ብእሲት — our women (noun, plural አንስት, stem አንስቲያ- + -ነ '1cp our')
ነጽሮ: ነጸረ — looking, to look (verbal noun/infinitive ነጽሮ of ነጸረ)
ሕፃናቲነ: ሕፃን — our little ones, children (noun, plural ሕፃናት, stem ሕፃናቲ- + -ነ '1cp our')
ለእጓለ: እጓል — to the child of (ለ- + noun, construct 'child of'; እጓለ ማውታ 'orphan')
ማውታ: ሙት — the dead; carrion (plural ማውታ, cf. ዕጓለ ማውታ 'orphan', lit. 'child of the dead'; sense here uncertain)
ማእምራን: ማእምር — knowing one, wise man (noun, plural ማእምራን 'those who know')
ሰሚዐ: ሰምዐ — to hear, hearing (infinitive, G; infinitive absolute before ሰማዕከ, 'truly hear')
ለሕይወትነ: ሕይወት — our life (ለ- marking the object + noun + -ነ '1cp our')
ዘያፈቅር: አፍቀረ — who loves (ዘ- 'who' + 3ms imperfect, causative; ፍቅር 'love')
ኢገበርነ: ገብረ — we did not do (negative ኢ- + 1cp perfect, g-b-r)
ክብረ: ክብር — glory, honour (construct 'glory of') · accusative 'glory' (ወሀቦሙ ክብረ 'he gave them glory')
ዘይከውን: ኮነ — who will be (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect)
ዘይነብር: ነበረ — dwell, sit, remain (3ms imperfect; ዘ- 'who')
ለዓለም: ዓለም — for ever (ለ- 'to, for' + noun 'age, world, eternity') · 'of the world', the owner after an anticipating suffix (ብርሃኖ ለዓለም 'the light of the world')
ዘለዓለም: ለዓለም — everlasting, eternal (ዘ- 'of' + ለዓለም 'for ever'; ክብረ ዘለዓለም 'glory of eternity')
ወሰጊድ: ሰጊድ — and bowing down, adoration (ወ- 'and' + noun, verbal noun of ሰገደ)
ወበእንተ: በእንተ — and concerning, about (ወ- + preposition) · and on account of, because of (ወበእንተ እከዮሙ 'and because of their evil')
ለታቦተ: ታቦት — to/of the ark (ለ- + noun, construct 'ark of') · marking the object, doubled by the suffix on the verb (ወንሥኣ ለታቦተ ሕጉ 'and take the Ark of his law')
ወወሀባ: ወሀበ — and he gave her (ወ- + 3ms perfect + -ኣ '3fs her')
ወሕጎ: ሕግ — and his law (ወ- + noun + -ኦ '3ms his', accusative)
ወአብርሀ: አብርሀ — and he/it shone (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative)
ላዕሌሆሙ: ላዕለ — upon them, over them (preposition + 3mp suffix)
በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
ክረምተ: ክረምት — winter, rainy season (noun, f.; accusative/construct form)
ወሐጋየ: ሐጋይ — and summer (ወ- 'and' + noun; accusative form in -a)
ዘርአ: ዘርእ — seed (construct 'seed of') · also 'seed' as sown grain, absolute (ዘርአ ወማእረረ 'seed(time) and harvest') · accusative 'offspring' (ይሁበኒ እግዚኣብሔር ዘርአ 'may God give me offspring') · in apposition to ውሉድ: 'offspring' (አልቦውሉደ ዘርአ 'no child, no seed')
ወማእረረ: ማእረር — and harvest (ወ- 'and' + noun; accusative form)
ወወርኀ: ወርኅ — and moon (ወ- + noun, accusative; also 'month')
እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
ሀለወት: ሀለወ — she was, she was present (3fs perfect, h-l-w)
ወከመ: ከመ — that, so that (conjunction; ወ- 'and') · and as (ወከመ ዝ 'and as this') · 'and like' before a noun (ወከመ ድምፀ አንበሳ 'and like the voice of a lion')
ለሰማይ: ሰማይ — the heaven, sky (ለ- marking the object + noun)
ሰብአ: ሰብእ — man (accusative) · construct 'men of' (ሰብአ ቤቱ 'men of his house')
ወእንስሳ: እንስሳ — and livestock, animals (ወ- + collective noun, accusative)
ወአራዊተ: አርዌ — and beasts (ወ- + plural አራዊት, accusative/construct 'beasts of')
ወለኵሉ: ኵሉ — and to all, for all (ወ- + ለ- + ኵሉ)
ተሀየየነ: ተሀየየ — he turned away from us (3ms perfect, Gt stem, root h-y-y, + -ነ '1cp us'); sense uncertain (?)
ወነሥኣ: ነሥአ — and he took her (ወ- + 3ms perfect, n-ś-ʾ + -ኣ 'her')
ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
ይብል: ብህለ — he says (3ms imperfect, G stem, defective verb b-h-l)
ብካየ: ብካይ — weeping (noun, accusative; cognate object of በከየ 'wept', ብካየ መሪረ 'bitter weeping')
ወአውሥአ: አውሥአ — and he answered (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ወሥአ)
በፈቃደ: ፈቃድ — by the will of (በ- 'by' + noun, construct 'will of')
ኮነ: ኮነ — he became, was (3m sg perfect, k-w-n) · 3ms form used here where 'we became' is meant (እንዘ ጠቢባን ኮነ አብዳነ; 1cp would be ኮንነ; sic) · 'if it is' after ለእመ (ወለእመ ኮነ ተባዕተ 'and if it is male'); impersonal 'when it was to him' of years (ሶበ ኮነ ሎቱ ፳ወ፪ ዓመተ 'when he was twenty-two')
ወይእቲኒ: ይእቲ — and she also (ወ- + 3fs pronoun + enclitic -ኒ)
ለባዕድ: ባዕድ — to another, a strange one (ለ- + noun/adjective)
ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
አቡከ: አብ — father (noun, genitive after construct; + -ከ 'your', 2ms, form አቡ-)
ለዳዊት: ዳዊት — to David (ለ- + proper name) · to the young prince Menelik, styled David (ንንግሮ ለዳዊት እግዚእነ 'let us tell David our lord')
ወኢይኔስሕ: ነስሐ — and he will not repent (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms imperfect ይኔስሕ, G)
እምፍሬ: ፍሬ — from the fruit of (እም- + noun, construct)
ታቦተ: ታቦት — ark, tabernacle (construct 'ark of') · also accusative 'an ark' (ግበር ታቦተ 'make an ark')
እምነገሥተ: ንጉሥ — from the kings of (እም- + plural construct 'kings of')
መዋዕለ: ዕለት — day (noun, plural መዋዕል 'days', accusative / construct)
ወርኅ: ወርኅ — moon, month (noun; construct 'of the moon')
ወበሰማያትኒ: ሰማይ — and in the heavens also (ወ- + በ- + plural ሰማያት + enclitic -ኒ)
ይኴንን: ኰነነ — he rule, judge (3ms imperfect/jussive, D)
ሕያዋነ: ሕያው — living ones (adjective used as noun, plural ሕያዋን, accusative)
ወሙታነ: ሙት — and dead ones (ወ- + noun, plural ሙታን, accusative)
ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this'
ወይሰግዱ: ሰገደ — and they will bow down (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, s-g-d)
ወበዝንቱ: ዝንቱ — this (demonstrative, masc. sg.; በ- 'by, in', ወ- 'and')
ፍጹመ: ፍጹም — perfectly, completely (adjective as adverbial accusative) · predicate accusative 'perfect' (ኩን ፍጹመ 'be perfect')
ይኩን: ኮነ — let him be (3m sg jussive, k-w-n)
አስተርአዮ: አስተርአየ — it appeared to him (3ms perfect + -ዮ 'to him')
ገሃደ: ገሃድ — openly, evident (adjective as adverbial accusative)
ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
ወአንተሰ: አንተ — and as for you (ወ- + 2ms pronoun + emphatic -ሰ)
ሐነጽከ: ሐነጸ — you built (2ms perfect, G, ḥ-n-ṣ)
ይእቲ: ይእቲ — she/it is (fem. pron.) · 'I am she' predicate (አነ ይእቲ አቡከ 'I am she, your father') · 'that' (fem. demonstrative, ይእቲ ሠሉስ ዕለት 'that third day')
ለእመ: እመ — if (conditional conjunction, ለእመ) · 'whether', introducing an indirect question (ለእመ ብኪ ትትባረክ 'whether through you she will be blessed') (?) · ለ- + እም 'mother' in construct: 'to the mother of' (ለእመ ዝንቱ ወሬዛ 'to the mother of this lad')
ዐቀብከ: ዐቀበ — you have kept, guarded (2ms perfect, ʿ-q-b)
ትእዛዞ: ትእዛዝ — his command (noun + -ሁ '3ms his', anticipating ለእግዚኣብሔር 'the command of God') · his commandment, as a plain object with no owner named after it (ዐቀብከ ትእዛዞ 'you have kept his commandment')
ባዕደ: ባዕድ — other, foreign (adjective, accusative masc. sg., agreeing with አማልክተ)
ትትፈቀር: ተፈቀረ — she is loved (3fs imperfect, tä-stem passive of ፈቀረ; ጥበብ is fem.)
በኀበ: ኀበ — before, with, in the presence of (በ- + ኀበ) · among (በኀበ ማእምራን 'among the knowing') · 'where' (conj.) (በኀበ ሀለውኩ 'where I am')
